title: Grateful Dead Live at Glen Helen Regional Park on 1982-09-05
lineage: Cassette Master (Nakamichi DR-1/Dolby B) -> Sound Devices 744T (24bit/48k) -> Samplitude Professional v11.03 -> FLAC/16
source: (FOB) Sony ECM-220T -> Cassette Master (Sony TC-D5M/Fuji Metal Tape/Dolby B)

ai_review.summary: A solid sound‑board capture of a strong US Festival set – high energy performance, though the stadium PA leaves the bass thin and vocals a bit echoey.
ai_review.review: The shows from this era are praised as part of a very strong touring period, with reviewers calling it fantastic and noting the impressive production at the US Festival. The recording is a front‑of‑house (soundboard) source that generally sounds good but suffers from thin low end and some vocal echo due to the large stadium acoustics.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviewers are enthusiastic (average 4.7★) and highlight a strong performance; recording issues are minor, leading to an overall high rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Bass is thin, vocals have slight echo, and the mix lacks punch compared to smaller venues – likely due to stadium PA acoustics. Overall clarity is decent.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Festival‑short set that fits into a powerful touring stretch; energy remains high throughout despite limited length.
